Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Recent allies of the Sabbat, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.Ei698TPekL0hRbUS]{Salubri} antitribu - sometimes called the Furies - care little for the sect's broader ideology, joining out of necessity and shared hatred of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, whom they blame for destroying their clan's progenitor. Driven by vengeance, they fight as furious, almost cult-like zealots devoted to avenging their founder, though private grudges can easily distract them from larger goals.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Valeren

Advantage: Each Salubri antitribu gains one free Occult Ability at character creation from their study of the world's supernatural mysteries. A player may also choose to have the character assume a Path of Enlightenment at creation, granting one free Morality Trait (this cannot raise a beginning character above three Morality Traits).

Disadvantage: Passionate and angry, the Salubri antitribu must take their sustenance from fallen enemies or by force - blood freely offered grants no Blood Trait benefit. The bloodline is also small, with a narrow spectrum of generations: all Salubri antitribu must begin the game between 10th and 12th Generation.

Organization: The Salubri antitribu function almost as a cult bound by shared grief and vengeance, their fervor giving them purpose even as outsiders to the Sabbat's wider cause.
